cross_paper_per_question.question: How do the Extractive Reader in DPR and Generative RAG compare on TriviaQA exact match performance?
cross_paper_per_question.expected_distinction: DPR extractive reader holds modest advantage (57.9 vs 56.8) on standard open-domain split, but RAG-Sequence dominates (68.0 vs 56.8) on TQA-Wiki split.
